dataset: Stanford Online Products official TRAIN split only; no official test image bytes
split: seed-179019 class-disjoint 53700 fit / 5851 holdout images; each holdout row is a query
representation: pretrained and selected step-48000 SOP-trained UNICOM B/16 768-D source features, normalized float32 cosine with TF32 disabled
positive_set: all other holdout images with the query product label, fixed across negative-pool arms
negative_pools: wrong-product holdout rows from identities unseen in backbone training
fit rows from identities seen in backbone training
estimand: for each query and pool, exact probability that N uniformly sampled wrong-product rows without replacement contain no negative outranking the strongest positive; ties resolve by lower gallery ordinal; expectation is C(M-K,N)/C(M,N)
comparison: seen-minus-unseen expected Recall@1 at equal negative count, separately for pretrained and trained embeddings; then trained minus pretrained interaction
baseline_parity: selected trained archive must reproduce holdout-only R1 0.9603486583490002 and full-train-gallery R1 0.8858314817979832 from prior authenticated census
interpretation: descriptive seen-class effect at equal sampled gallery size; pretraining contrast controls some preexisting pool differences, not all possible dataset confounding; no method or official-test claim
